headings.usage: Use Manrope for all headings. Ensure tracking-tight for H1-H3 to maintain a premium tech look.

body.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for all body text, tables, and UI controls for maximum legibility.

typography.import_instruction: Add Google Fonts imports for 'Manrope' and 'IBM Plex Sans' to index.html or global css.

primary_brand.structure_description: Midnight blue for sidebar, header text, and primary structure.

warning.description: Orange for pending actions (actions en attente).

error.description: Red for errors, refusals, and exclusions (erreurs/refus/exclusions).

info.description: Blue for prospects in progress (prospects en cours).

surfaces.neumorphism_avoid: Do not use soft UI everywhere. Use sharp inner contrasts.
surfaces.glassmorphism: Not recommended for this data-heavy CRM unless for a floating action bar. Stick to solid white backgrounds with 1px border for clarity.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-lg font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.danger: bg-red-50 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-100 rounded-lg font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-all

cards.base: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6
cards.kpi: flex flex-col gap-2 p-6 bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm

badges.base: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

inputs.base: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all

grids.bento_spacing: Always use gap-6 for dashboard layouts. Use generous padding inside widgets (p-6).

layouts.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 flex flex-col border-r border-slate-800 hidden md:flex
layouts.header: h-16 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between px-6 sticky top-0 z-10

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions. e.g., 'transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out', 'transition-transform duration-200 active:scale-95'. Avoid 'transition-all' for complex components.
motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have a defined hover state (darker bg or slightly elevated shadow).
motion.list_animations: Stagger entrance for data table rows or KPI cards using framer-motion if possible, else simple CSS fade-in.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use gray-on-gray.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. Prefer clean, professional icon styles. Avoid AI emojis.
media.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts for performance dashboard. Use distinct colors for sectors and funnel stages.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific CRM dashboard as maximum legibility and speed are the priorities. Rely on 2D charts (Recharts).

avatars.description: Elegant portrait of a young male professional for contact/user profile.
Professional female portrait for contact/user profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building PROSPECTIA, a premium SaaS AI-powered B2B sales prospecting CRM in French.
Implement a fixed sidebar on desktop and mobile-adapted navigation. Sidebar background is slate-900 (Midnight Blue).
Use Shadcn UI components but customize them to match the clean, slightly rounded (8px radius) style.
Build the dashboard with KPI stat cards, charts (funnel, status, sector), and 'Actions prioritaires aujourd'hui'.
Implement complex data tables for Prospects and Contacts with filters, search, bulk actions, and status badges using the exact colors provided in the guidelines.
Create the AI digital analysis view and prospect scoring detail (score /100 with breakdown).
Build an AI email generation editor with variants, and a human validation queue layout.
Ensure all text is in French as requested.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns.
Do not center-align app containers; use standard left-aligned data layouts.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Use standard Recharts for the KPI dashboard charts.
Install standard dependencies: @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react, recharts, framer-motion, sonner.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for testing.
